INSIDE-CANARY-7f3a91

**Tools available to me:**

1. **Glob** — Fast file pattern matching tool that works with any codebase size; supports glob patterns and returns matching file paths sorted by modification time
2. **Grep** — Powerful search tool built on ripgrep; supports full regex syntax, filtering by file type/glob, and multiple output modes (content, files_with_matches, count)
3. **Read** — Reads files from the local filesystem; supports line/offset ranges, PDF pages, Jupyter notebooks, and image files
